'''We Energies Lakeshore Lateral''' is a construction natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://miningconnection.com/gos/news/article/work_underway_at_we_energies_natural_gas_pipeline_in_southeastern_wisconsin|title=miningconnection.com|website=miningconnection.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline is proposed to run from Bluff Creek Gate Station, La Grange, Wisconsin to Mount Pleasant, Racine County, Wisconsin.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.gazettextra.com/news/government/pipeline-proposal-through-walworth-county-is-revised-again-more-public-hearings-set/article_abda14e5-dd2e-5158-8fc2-7d82f2e5aae7.html|title=gazettextra.com|website=gazettextra.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
